responsibility: This definition module declares GNU Modula-2 bindings for a broad set of GCC built-in and libc-like intrinsic operations, spanning floating-point math, complex arithmetic, memory and string primitives, stack/frame inspection, and special runtime helpers such as setjmp/longjmp and alloca_trace. It belongs to the compiler/runtime interface layer and defines the public intrinsic signatures and ADDRESS-based entry points that generated gm2 code and low-level libraries can call when they need direct access to compiler-recognized builtins rather than higher-level wrappers like MathLib0 or MemUtils.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Builtins pair: it declares the large public surface of __BUILTIN__ procedures and low-level helper entry points, while Builtins.mod supplies the compiler-annotated bodies and fallback bindings to cbuiltin/wrapc.
